message.content: {"action":"check","sql":"SELECT a.id, COUNT(i.id) AS qualifying_count FROM accounts_202 a JOIN items_202 i ON i.account_id = a.id WHERE a.active = 1 AND a.id NOT IN (SELECT account_id FROM blocks_202 WHERE account_id IS NOT NULL) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM items_202 bad WHERE bad.account_id = a.id AND (bad.status IS NULL OR bad.status <> 'ok' OR bad.amount IS NULL OR bad.amount < 63)) GROUP BY a.id ORDER BY a.id"}
